title: Counting repeated songs on his records
summary: He plans to count which song he has recorded most, such as Honeysuckle Rose.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: One of these days I'm going to check up to see how many... I'm going to check all the records I made and see how many times I made the same song over again, just to see which one is in the lead...whether it's "St. James Infirmary," or "Sweet Georgia Brown"...
Or "Honeysuckle Rose." Well, what do you think now?
How much time you got? You got...?
Oh, I think it's only a matter of minutes.
